## What was implemented

### PRs #1–#5: Upstream seams (existing files, surgical changes)

| PR | Change | Key files |
|---|---|---|
| #1 | `createPostgresDb` + backwards-compat `createDb` alias | [packages/db/src/client.ts](packages/db/src/client.ts#L48-L53), [index.ts](packages/db/src/index.ts) |
| #2 | `"r2"` added to `STORAGE_PROVIDERS`, `storageR2ConfigSchema`, `registerStorageProvider()` extension point | [packages/shared/src/constants.ts:331](packages/shared/src/constants.ts#L331), [config-schema.ts](packages/shared/src/config-schema.ts), [server/src/storage/provider-registry.ts](server/src/storage/provider-registry.ts) |
| #3 | Audit of all 20+ `fs`-using files; `// TODO(cloudflare):` comments at every site | 20 files across `routes/` and `services/` |
| #4 | `Scheduler` interface + `createNodeScheduler()` (Node `setInterval` impl); `server/src/index.ts` swapped to use it | [server/src/scheduler/types.ts](server/src/scheduler/types.ts), [node-scheduler.ts](server/src/scheduler/node-scheduler.ts), [index.ts](server/src/index.ts) |
| #5 | `CommandExecutor` interface + `createLocalCommandExecutor()` wrapper; `runChildProcess` gets optional `executor` param | [packages/adapter-utils/src/executor.ts](packages/adapter-utils/src/executor.ts), [local-executor.ts](packages/adapter-utils/src/local-executor.ts) |

### PRs #6–#7: HTTP Handler shape

- [server/src/http/types.ts](server/src/http/types.ts) — `Handler`, `RequestCtx`, `ActorContext`, `RouteDefinition`
- [server/src/http/express-adapter.ts](server/src/http/express-adapter.ts) — bridges Express req/res → `RequestCtx` / Web `Response`
- [server/src/routes/health.ts](server/src/routes/health.ts) — first route migrated to `Handler` shape as the reference pattern for all others

### PRs #8–#12: `packages/deploy-cloudflare/` (20 new files)

```
wrangler.toml          — full resource declaration (R2, KV, Hyperdrive, 3 DOs, 2 Workflows, Queues, Cron)
src/db/hyperdrive.ts   — createHyperdriveDb() Phase 1 DB driver
src/storage/r2-provider.ts     — R2Provider implementing StorageProvider
src/scheduler/scheduler-do.ts  — SchedulerDO (alarm-based, full HTTP API)
src/scheduler/cf-scheduler.ts  — CF Scheduler impl
src/runtime/task-do.ts         — TaskDO with WS Hibernation API
src/runtime/agent-run-do.ts    — AgentRunDO
src/runtime/workflows/heartbeat.ts       — HeartbeatWorkflow (3 durable steps)
src/runtime/workflows/plugin-dispatch.ts — PluginDispatchWorkflow
src/adapter-executor/sandbox-bridge.ts   — SandboxBridgeExecutor (HTTP to E2B/SSH bridge)
src/adapter-executor/container.ts        — ContainerExecutor (CF Container binding)
src/http/hono-adapter.ts       — mounts Handler routes under Hono
src/worker/api.ts              — main Worker entry (Hono, setup gate, queue consumer, cron stubs)
src/worker/mcp-sse.ts          — MCP-over-SSE Worker
src/worker/setup.ts            — full first-run setup form (validates, writes to KV)
src/boot.ts                    — registerStorageProvider("r2", ...) on boot
deploy/post-deploy-setup.md    — operator install guide
deploy/deploy-button.md        — README snippet
README.md                      — Deploy to Cloudflare button added
package.json / tsconfig.json
```

---

### Key outstanding work (PR #3 found more than expected)

The filesystem audit revealed that the following are deep architectural migrations, not quick substitutions — they need their own PRs with proper design:

- **`run-log-store.ts` / `workspace-operation-log-store.ts`** — cleanest to migrate, already interface-abstracted, just need R2 implementations
- **`company-skills.ts` / `agent-instructions.ts`** — skill file trees need R2 + D1 inventory tables
- **Plugin system** (`plugin-loader.ts`, `plugin-runtime-sandbox.ts`, `workspace-runtime.ts`) — entire process model needs sidecar split; each has detailed TODOs

All TODOs are in place in the code so you know exactly what needs migrating and why, without any of it being removed or broken for the existing Node deployment.
